testsuite.name: run.trama.e2e.E2EDefinitionLifecycleTest

testcase.name: DELETE removes the definition from every lookup path()
v2 definition is stored, listed and fetched by name and version()
PUT creates with an explicit id and is insert-only()
running a stored v1 definition passes the payload to templates()
invalid definitions are rejected with 400 and a list of errors()
running a stored v2 definition is rejected as not yet supported()
